verdict.rationale: Dropbox's own pages show a desktop offering and cross-device file sync, and say it can 'save hard drive space on your devices', which hints at online-only files. The evidence never names macOS or Windows clients, never mentions selective sync, and never explicitly describes on-demand or online-only files. Missing for 10: explicit official macOS/Windows desktop client documentation, selective sync documentation, explicit on-demand/online-only files feature, hands-on corroboration that sync just works.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files

citations.quote: Migrate your files to Dropbox to keep them securely synced across devices.
Securely store your content in the cloud and save hard drive space on your devices, with Dropbox.
